info.title: TarotGen.io API
info.description:
The backend for **TarotGen.io** — a PHP 8.5 / Slim 4 hybrid-REST API.

- Resources are plural nouns (`/decks`, `/readings`); items are `/{id}`.
- `GET` reads, `POST` creates (→`201`) or runs a command, `PUT` replaces,
  `PATCH` applies a partial update / flag toggle, `DELETE` removes (→`204`).
- State transitions that aren't a plain field-set are `POST …/{id}/{verb}`
  (e.g. `…/finalize`, `…/approve`, `…/draw`).
- Errors are `{ "error": "…" }`; multi-message validation is `{ "errors": […] }`.
- Auth is a session cookie (`PHPSESSID`) set by the `/auth/*` endpoints —
  there are no API keys or bearer tokens for first-party calls.

get.summary: The current user's readings, newest first (one page with ?limit, else all), optionally filtered
get.description: Every filter is optional and they combine; a blank one is no filter.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size (1–100). Omit to get every reading.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Text in the name, notes, question or querent (ignoring case for unaccented letters).

parameters.name: spread
parameters.description: Laid out in a spread of this name, as the reading recorded it (personal spreads have no public id); "Free Draw" also matches a free draw never placed.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Made on or after this day (YYYY-MM-DD) in `tz`.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Made on or before this day (YYYY-MM-DD) in `tz`.

parameters.name: tz
parameters.description: The reader's time zone for `from` and `to` (IANA, e.g. Europe/London); UTC when absent.

parameters.name: daily
parameters.description: only: daily cards alone; exclude: everything but.

X-Total-Count.description: How many of the user's readings the filters match (sent when paging with ?limit)

400.description: A filter that cannot be one (a bad date, deck id, time zone or daily value; from after to)

get.summary: The tags on the user's readings, with how many readings carry each
get.description: Alphabetical. For My Readings' tag filter and tag suggestions while writing one.

get.summary: The spreads the user's readings were laid out in, with how many readings each
get.description: Alphabetical, by the name the readings recorded; names that differ only in case are one spread. Each is a value for GET /account/readings?spread= that finds exactly that many readings, so My Readings' spread filter never offers a spread with none.

patch.summary: Update a reading's name, notes, hidden-author flag, journal fields, or who can open it
patch.description: Only the fields sent change. `visibility`: link (anyone with the link) and private (only you) drop any password; password needs `password` unless the reading has one already. Without `visibility`, `password` sets a password (and makes it a password reading) and `remove_password` drops it.

question.description: Up to 500 characters; blank or null clears it.

querent.description: Up to 100 characters; blank or null clears it.

tags.description: Replaces every tag: at most 10, of at most 30 characters each; stored lower-case, a leading # dropped, repeats merged. [] clears them.

400.description: No changes provided, an unknown visibility, or tags over the limits

422.description: Password too short, or Password chosen without one

delete.summary: Delete one of the user's readings
delete.description: Delete one of the current user's readings.

get.summary: Download the user's whole journal, every reading, as JSON or CSV
get.description: A file download (Content-Disposition: attachment), newest reading first. JSON keeps everything: the spread snapshot with its positions, the cards, the notes, the question, querent and tags, who can open it, and the flags (never a view password). CSV has one row per drawn card, so a reading's name, journal fields and notes repeat on each of its rows; it is UTF-8 with a byte-order mark (for Excel), and a cell that starts like a formula (= + - @, tab, CR) is prefixed with an apostrophe.

schema.description: Columns: Reading ID, Reading Time (UTC), Reading Name, Question, Querent, Tags (comma-separated), Privacy (Anyone with the link, Password or Private), Deck, Spread, Position, Position Title, Card, Reversed (Yes/No), Notes.

patch.summary: Update the account profile (currently the display name)
patch.description:
Partial update of the current account's profile. Currently the only
editable field is the display name (previously the dedicated
PUT /account/display-name).

delete.summary: Delete the account after re-entering the password (cascades readings)
delete.description: Ends every session of the account. An account without a password (made by signing in with Google) sets one first, through a password-reset link. A protected account (PROTECTED_ADMIN_EMAILS) cannot be deleted.

403.description: Wrong password, or a protected account

post.summary: Change the account password
post.description: Ends every other session of the account; the browser making the change stays signed in, under a new session id. Linked plugins keep their tokens (they're revoked under Connected Apps).

message.description: A confirmation to show the user.

422.description: Wrong current password or weak new password

post.summary: Sign out of every other device
post.description: Ends every session of the account but the browser asking, which stays signed in under a new session id, so a copy of its old cookie is signed out too. Linked plugins keep their tokens (they're revoked under Connected Apps).

ended.description: How many other sessions were signed out; 0 when none was.

get.description: List all of the current user's personal spreads.

post.summary: Create a personal spread
post.description: Create a new personal spread.

201.description: The created spread (card_count is the number of positions)

400.description: Name and positions required, or a position that is not an object

put.description: Update one of the current user's personal spreads.

200.description: The updated spread (card_count is the number of positions)

400.description: No changes provided, a blank name, or positions that are empty or not objects

delete.summary: Delete a personal spread (and any favorites pointing to it)
delete.description: Delete one of the current user's personal spreads.

post.summary: Submit a personal spread to the public pending queue
post.description:
Submit one of the user's personal spreads as a public spread (copies into
pending queue; the personal copy remains untouched).

get.description: List the current user's favorited spreads.

post.summary: Add a favorite spread
post.description: Add a spread to the current user's favorites.

delete.description:
Remove a spread from the current user's favorites. The favorite is
identified by its type and id in the path.

200.description: The ids of the favorited decks, oldest favorite first

post.summary: Add a favorite deck

400.description: Invalid deck ID: no such deck, or one not yet approved

get.summary: List reported cards with their reasons (open first; pass ?show_resolved=1 for all)

patch.summary: Mark a card report resolved / reopened

post.summary: Rebuild a reported card's web images from its replaced master scan, then resolve the report
post.description:
The last step of fixing a reported card, once its new master scan is on
the server: rebuild that one card's web images and, only if that worked,
resolve the report. The images are rebuilt even when they look current,
since an upload may keep the old scan's timestamp.

200.description: Images rebuilt and the report resolved

409.description: Already resolved, or the card has no master scan on the server

500.description: The scan could not be turned into web images; the report stays open

post.summary: Create a changelog entry

404.description: Changelog entry not found or no valid fields

parameters.name: show_read
parameters.description: Set to "1" to include already-read messages

patch.description:
Partial update of a contact message. Currently the only editable field is
the `is_read` flag (previously the dedicated POST …/read action).

get.description:
One-shot dashboard payload: entity counts (cheap COUNT(*) queries) plus the
usage stats overview — so the dashboard loads with a single request.

counts.description: Row counts for the dashboard tiles.

unreadContacts.description: Contact messages not yet marked read.

openCardReports.description: Reported cards not yet resolved (one per card).

post.summary: Create a deck

409.description: A deck with that name already exists

post.summary: Approve a pending deck
Generate missing or stale web images (display WebP + thumbnail) for a deck

200.description: Per-card counts: generated, skipped (already current), failed

post.summary: Generate missing or stale web images for all decks

200.description: Per-card totals across decks: generated, skipped (already current), failed

requestBody.description: Partial set of deck fields to update

400.description: Name is required (a name sent blank)

404.description: Deck not found or no valid fields

409.description: Another deck already has that name

post.summary: Add a special card to a deck

409.description: The deck already has a special card with that card_id

get.summary: Get a single deck system with its cards

200.description: The deck system plus its cards array

put.summary: Update a deck system and its cards

409.description: Another deck system already has that name

post.summary: Approve a pending deck system

total.description: Every stored reading, across all pages.

delete.summary: Purge guest readings older than a given age
delete.description:
Bulk delete: purge guest readings older than the given age. The window is
an allow-listed number of days passed as the `older_than_days` query param.

post.summary: Add a category at the end of the list

delete.summary: Remove a category that holds no spreads

409.description: It still holds spreads (move them first), or it is the last category

put.summary: Put the categories in a new order

category_ids.description: Every category id, once, in the new order. The first becomes the default for new spreads.

200.description: Every category, in the new order

400.description: Not every category id exactly once

post.summary: Create a public spread

category_id.description: Its library category; the first category when left out.

400.description: Name is required, or an unknown category

category_id.description: Move it to another library category.

400.description: Name is required (a name sent blank), or an unknown category

404.description: Spread not found or no valid fields

post.summary: Approve a pending spread submission

category_id.description: The library category to publish it in; the first category when left out.

post.summary: Activate a user account

patch.description: Removing the admin flag is refused (403) on your own account and on a protected one.

403.description: Removing your own admin flag, or a protected account's

delete.description: Ends every session of the account too. Refused (403) for your own account (Account Settings deletes that) and for a protected one.

403.description: Your own account, or a protected one

post.summary: Resend a user activation email

200.description: A new activation link was issued (replacing any earlier one)

emailed.description: Whether the activation email was sent.

activation_link.description: The new activation link. Sent only outside production, and only when the email was not sent.

get.summary: How often each card turned up in the user's readings (daily cards included)

parameters.name: deck_id
parameters.description: Count one deck's readings only, card by card. Omit to count every deck, a card by its name.

parameters.name: days
parameters.description: Count readings from the last this many days (1–3650). Omit for all time.

400.description: deck_id or days is not a whole number in range

post.summary: Report a problem with a card's image (rate-limited)

reason.description: Sent by the site and current plugin builds. Older plugin builds omit it; their reports only bump the counter.

details.description: What is wrong, in the reporter's words. Required when reason is `other`.

200.description: Already reported this card recently (counter not bumped)

400.description: Missing/invalid deck or card id, unknown reason, or `other` without details

429.description: Too many reports from this IP

200.description: Non-secret config the SPA needs before rendering

post.summary: Submit a contact-form message (rate-limited: 5/IP/hour)
post.description:
Public endpoint: submit a contact form message.
Rate-limited per IP to prevent spam.

get.summary: The user's daily cards in one month, for the calendar

200.description: One per day drawn, oldest first; a day without a draw is left out; a day whose reading was deleted is still listed, its reading and card null

400.description: month is missing or not YYYY-MM

post.summary: Draw the user's daily card for their day
post.description: A one-card reading from the chosen deck, owned by the user and named "Daily card — 30 October 2026" after the day sent, which is the browser's local date: accepted only within a day of the server's UTC date. Deleting that reading doesn't free the day: it stays drawn, with no reading.

400.description: day is not a date within a day of today (UTC), or the deck is missing, unknown or awaiting approval

409.description: The day already has its card, or had one whose reading was deleted

reading_id.description: The reading already drawn for the day; null when it was deleted.

post.summary: Submit a new deck for review (requires a signed-in user)
post.description:
Submit a new deck (requires a logged-in user). The deck is created
as unapproved (pending admin review).

409.description: A deck with that name already exists

get.summary: A single deck (one still awaiting approval only to an admin)

404.description: InvalidDeckID: no such deck, or one awaiting approval and the viewer is not an admin

get.summary: List every card available in a deck (for the custom-reading picker; a deck awaiting approval only to an admin)
get.description:
List every card available in a deck as {card_id, name}, so the custom
reading screen can offer a picker. Mirrors the reading engine's card
resolution.

404.description: InvalidDeckID: no such deck, or one awaiting approval and the viewer is not an admin

get.description: Public: list all approved deck systems.

post.summary: Submit a new deck system (requires a signed-in user; admins are auto-approved)
post.description: Submit a new deck system (requires auth). If admin, auto-approved.

409.description: A deck system with that name already exists

get.summary: A single deck system with its cards (one still awaiting approval only to an admin)
get.description:
Public: get a single deck system with its cards. One still awaiting
approval is shown only to an admin; anyone else gets the answer for an
unknown id, so pending submissions can't be found by probing ids.

200.description: The deck system plus its cards array

404.description: Deck system not found, or awaiting approval and the viewer is not an admin

get.description:
Initiate the OAuth flow. Accepts an optional ?intent query param
('login', 'register', or 'link') so the callback knows what to do.

401.description: The link intent requires a session

get.summary: OAuth callback — redirects back into the SPA on success/failure
get.description: Handle the OAuth callback from Google.

post.summary: Unlink Google from the current account
post.description: Only while the account can still sign in another way: a password (set, with password login on) or a passkey.

409.description: Google is the last way to sign in; the message says what to set up first

post.summary: Credential-creation options (requires session)
post.description: Generate WebAuthn credential creation options for the logged-in user.

publicKey.description: The PublicKeyCredentialCreationOptions for navigator.credentials.create(), with its binary fields (challenge, user.id, excludeCredentials[].id) base64url-encoded. excludeCredentials lists the passkeys already on the account.

post.summary: Complete passkey registration
post.description: Complete passkey registration: verify attestation and store credential.

post.summary: Assertion options; optional email scopes to a user's credentials
post.description: With an email, allowCredentials always lists credentials: the account's passkeys, or for an email with none (no account, or an account without passkeys) stand-ins that look the same and stay the same, so the answer doesn't say which emails have accounts. Without one, any discoverable passkey may answer.

publicKey.description: The PublicKeyCredentialRequestOptions for navigator.credentials.get(), with its binary fields (challenge, allowCredentials[].id) base64url-encoded. allowCredentials is present whenever an email was given (the account's passkeys, or stand-ins); without one, any discoverable passkey may answer.

post.summary: Verify an assertion and sign in
post.description: Verify a passkey assertion and log the user in.

delete.summary: Delete a passkey (refused when it is the last way to sign in)
delete.description: The last passkey can go only while the account can still sign in another way: a password (set, with password login on) or a linked Google account.

409.description: The last way to sign in; the message says what to set up first

patch.summary: Toggle password login on/off (turning it off needs a passkey or a linked Google account)

user.description: The account as it now stands.

409.description: Turning it off would leave no way to sign in; the message says what to set up first

post.summary: Approve a plugin link and mint a PKCE authorization code (browser, session-authed)

200.description: Loopback redirect target carrying the authorization code

post.summary: Exchange a PKCE authorization code for a plugin Bearer token. Rate-limited: 10 attempts/IP/minute.

get.summary: The signed-in user's linked plugin tokens (Connected Apps)

200.description: Array of linked tokens (never includes the token value)

delete.summary: Revoke a linked plugin token (forces the plugin to re-link)

get.summary: Fetch a reading (password-protected readings return a locked stub to non-owners)

200.description: The reading, or — when it has a password this requester has not given — the locked stub

404.description: InvalidReadingID: no such reading, one past its expiry, or someone else's private reading

post.summary: Unlock a password-protected reading for this session

404.description: InvalidReadingID: no such reading, one past its expiry, or someone else's private reading

post.summary: Generate a random reading from a draw spec

requestBody.description: Draw spec: deck, spread or card count, and options. A `user_spread_id` counts only for its owner (signed in, or by plugin token): anyone else's is ignored, like an id that does not exist. A signed-in reader may also send `reading_name`, `reading_notes`, `hide_user`, `question` (up to 500 characters), `querent` (up to 100), `tags` (a list, or one comma-separated string: at most 10, of at most 30 characters each; stored lower-case) and `visibility` (link, password with `password`, or private); a guest's are ignored. A guest may send `expires_in_days` (1, 7 or 30) to have the reading deleted then instead of after the usual year; a signed-in reader's is ignored.

400.description: Invalid draw spec (InvalidDeckID also for a deck awaiting approval, unless an admin draws)

post.summary: Create a custom reading from explicitly chosen cards/positions

requestBody.description: The deck, a name and the cards with their positions, plus the same owner options as POST /readings/generate (a signed-in reader's) or expiry (a guest's).

201.description: The created reading, as stored (not the viewer payload the other reading commands return)

400.description: Invalid input (InvalidDeckID also for a deck awaiting approval, unless an admin records it)

put.summary: Save spread/placement positions onto an existing reading
put.description:
Update a reading's spread/placement information after a "Free Draw With Placement"
has been generated. The caller provides position data which is merged into the
existing reading_info JSON as a spread snapshot.

400.description: Position count mismatch or invalid data

404.description: Reading not found: no such reading, one past its expiry, or someone else's private reading

post.summary: Draw additional cards into a non-final, non-custom reading you own
post.description:
Draw additional cards into an existing generated reading owned by the
caller. The new cards are appended to the draw; for a spread reading the
client then opens the placement editor to position them.

404.description: Reading not found: no such reading, one past its expiry, or someone else's private reading

post.summary: Permanently lock a reading against further draws (owner-only, one-way)
post.description:
Mark a reading as final, permanently locking it against further draws.
One-way: there is no endpoint to undo it. Owner-only.

404.description: Reading not found: no such reading, one past its expiry, or someone else's private reading

post.summary: Submit a spread into the moderation queue (rate-limited: 5/IP/hour)
post.description:
Public endpoint: accept a user-submitted spread into the pending queue.
Rate-limited per IP to prevent spam. Never exposes the stored row.

post.summary: Copy a public spread into the signed-in user's own spreads (My Spreads)
post.description: The copy keeps the description and every position (with its description); its name gets " (copy)", or " (copy 2)" and on when the user already has that name. Only a published spread can be copied.

post.summary: Create an account (inactive until email activation). Rate-limited: 5/IP/hour.
post.description: An email that already has an account gets the same 201 and message as a new one (no account enumeration): nothing is created, and that address is emailed a notice that someone tried to sign up with it. A display name that is taken is still refused (names are public).

201.description: Account created (or, for an email that already has one, answered as if it had been)

message.description: What to do next, to show the user.

activation_link.description: The link that activates the new account. Sent only outside production, only for an account just created, and only when the activation email could not be sent.

422.description: Validation failure, or a display name that is taken

post.summary: Activate an account from the emailed token

message.description: A confirmation to show the user.

post.summary: Begin a password reset (always answers 200 — no account enumeration). Rate-limited: 5/IP/hour.

200.description: Identical response whether or not the account exists

message.description: The same wording either way, to show the user.

reset_link.description: The password-reset link. Sent only outside production, only for an account that exists, and only when the email could not be sent.

post.summary: Complete a password reset
post.description: Sets the new password, marks the account active, and ends every session of the account, so whoever knew the old password is signed out everywhere. Linked plugins keep their tokens (they're revoked under Connected Apps).

200.description: Password updated; account marked active; its sessions ended

message.description: A confirmation to show the user.

422.description: New password too weak (token not consumed)

post.summary: Password sign-in. Rate-limited: 10 failed attempts/IP/15 min.

200.description: Signed in; sets the session cookie

401.description: Invalid credentials (an unknown email, or an account without a password, takes as long to answer as a wrong password)

post.summary: Clear the session

200.description: Signed out (also when there was no session)

AdminUser.description: A user account as the admin user list shows it.

is_protected.description: Listed in PROTECTED_ADMIN_EMAILS: its admin access can't be removed and it can't be deleted.

SpreadPosition.description: One card slot in a spread layout.

order.description: 1-based: the nth card drawn goes here.

x.description: Card centre, % of the canvas width.

y.description: Card centre, % of the canvas height.

description.description: What the position asks about, e.g. "What stands in your way" — never what a card means. Trimmed; absent when it has none.

DrawCard.description: One drawn card, in draw order.

card_id.description: The card's number in its deck; a deck's extra cards come after its system's cards.

card_name.description: Absent when the deck has no name for the card (an extra card nobody has named yet).

SpreadSnapshot.description: The layout as it was when the reading was made, so a shared reading still renders after its spread is edited or deleted.

spread_id.description: The public spread it came from; 0 for a personal spread, a custom reading or a free-draw placement.

positions.description: One per drawn card. A position keeps its spread's description unless the reader retitled it; readings made before descriptions existed have none.

ReadingInfo.description: What was drawn, from which deck, in which layout.

deck_id.description: The deck the cards were drawn from.

origin.description: How it was made; a custom reading can't draw more cards. Absent on readings made before this was recorded.

spread.description: Absent for a free draw that was never placed.

ReadingView.description: A reading as the requester may see it: what GET /readings/{reading_id} and the reading commands (generate, unlock, draw, finalize) return.

reading_id.description: The code in the reading link.

reading_time.description: When it was made, UTC ("Y-m-d H:i:s").

reading_name.description: The owner's title for it, if any.

reader.description: "Guest", or the owner's display name unless they chose to hide it.

is_final.description: Locked for good against further draws.

can_draw_more.description: The requester may draw more cards into it: their own, not final, not custom.

visibility.description: Who can open it: anyone with the link, anyone with its password, or (private) only its owner.

expires_at.description: When this guest reading will be deleted, UTC ("Y-m-d H:i:s"), as its maker chose; null for the usual retention.

question.description: What was asked. Only in the owner's payload.

querent.description: Who the reading was for. Only in the owner's payload.

tags.description: The owner's tags, sorted. Only in the owner's payload.

hide_user.description: Whether the owner hid their name from it. Only in the owner's payload.

LockedReading.description: Sent instead of the reading to anyone but its owner until they unlock it with its password (POST /readings/{reading_id}/unlock).

reading_name.description: The owner's title for it, if any — the only thing shown before unlocking.

JournalExport.description: Every reading the user owns: the JSON journal download.

exported_at.description: When the file was made, UTC ("Y-m-d H:i:s").

JournalReading.description: One reading in the journal download.

reading_id.description: The code in the reading link.

reading_time.description: When it was made, UTC ("Y-m-d H:i:s").

reading_name.description: The owner's title for it, if any.

querent.description: Who the reading was for, if recorded.

deck_id.description: The deck the cards were drawn from.

spread.description: The layout as it was when the reading was made; null for a free draw that was never placed.

is_final.description: Locked for good against further draws.

visibility.description: Who can open it: anyone with the link, anyone with its password, or (private) only its owner.

password_protected.description: A view password is set (the password itself is never exported).

JournalCard.description: One drawn card in the journal download.

position.description: Its place in the draw, from 1; on a spread, the order of the position it lies in.

position_title.description: That position's title; null for a free draw, or a card drawn after the layout was placed.

card_id.description: The card's number in its deck.

card_name.description: "Card #{card_id}" when the deck has no name for it.

DeckSystemWithCards.description: A deck system with its card definitions: what viewing one returns (public and admin).

cards.description: The named cards, in card order.

RegisteredPasskey.description: The passkey just registered: its row as the account page lists it (Passkey), without credential_id.

created_at.description: When it was registered, UTC ("Y-m-d H:i:s").

last_used_at.description: Always null: it has not signed in yet.

UsageStats.description: Usage analytics over the stored readings, for the admin dashboard.

totals.description: How many readings are stored, and how many of them are recent.

byType.description: Every stored reading, by the layout it was given.

freeDraw.description: A free draw never placed in a layout.

spread.description: Laid out in a public spread.

custom.description: Laid out in a personal spread, a custom reading, or a placed free draw (spread_id 0).

topDecks.description: The (at most 10) decks with the most readings, most first.

topSpreads.description: The (at most 10) public spreads with the most readings, by name, most first.

name.description: The spread's name as the readings recorded it ("Untitled" if none).

daily.description: Readings per UTC day over the last 14 days, oldest first; a day with none is left out.

CardCount.description: One card and how often it was drawn.

card_name.description: The card's name as the readings recorded it, or `Card #<id>` for a card its deck had not named.

card_id.description: The card's number in its deck; null when counted by name across decks.

deck_id.description: The deck it was drawn from; null when counted by name across decks.

CardFrequency.description: How often each card turned up in the signed-in user's readings.

readings.description: Readings counted: those matching the deck and window.

deck_id.description: The deck counted, or null for every deck.

days.description: The window counted, in days back from now, or null for all time.

cards.description: Every card drawn, most often first (ties by name).

CardReport.description: A card users have reported as having a problem with its image.

deck_name.description: Resolved deck name (from the decks table).

report_count.description: How many times this card has been reported.

resolved_at.description: When an admin marked it handled; null = open.

round.description: Goes up each time the card is reported again after being resolved.

submissions.description: Each reason given, newest first. Older reports may have none.

CardReportReason.description: What is wrong with a reported card.

CardReportSubmission.description: One user's report of a card, with their reason.

round.description: The card's round when this was submitted (see CardReport.round).

details.description: What the reporter wrote; may be empty.

DailyCard.description: A day's daily card: the reading drawn for that day and the card it holds. A day whose reading was deleted stays drawn, with reading_id and every card field null.

day.description: The day it was drawn for: the owner's local date, "Y-m-d".

reading_id.description: The reading drawn for the day; null once that reading was deleted.

deck_id.description: Null once the reading was deleted.

deck_name.description: The deck's name, or `Deck #<id>` once the deck is gone; null once the reading was deleted.

card_id.description: The card's number in its deck; null once the reading was deleted.

card_name.description: The card's name as the reading recorded it, or `Card #<id>` when the deck had none; null once the reading was deleted.

reversed.description: Drawn upside down; null once the reading was deleted.

submitted_by.description: The account that submitted it. Admin views only.

system_short_name.description: Populated by JOIN queries — the deck system's short name.

system_total_cards.description: Populated by JOIN queries — the deck system's total cards.

DeckSystem.description: A tarot deck system (a family of decks sharing a card structure).

submitted_by.description: The account that submitted it. Admin views only.

DeckSystemCard.description: A card definition within a deck system.

FavoriteSpread.description: A favourited spread: which table it lives in, and its id there.

spread_type.description: `public` for an official spread, `personal` for a custom one.

spread_id.description: The spread_id or user_spread_id, according to spread_type.

Passkey.description: A passkey registered to the signed-in user's account.

positions.description:
Array of position objects, each shaped:
['order' => int, 'title' => string, 'x' => float, 'y' => float, 'rotation' => int,
 'description' => string (only when it has one)]

submitter.description: Resolved submitter label: the linked account's display name, or "Guest".

PluginToken.description: A linked-plugin personal access token (no secret value exposed).

Reading.description: A saved reading as stored — what the account pages and custom-reading creation return. Viewing a reading returns ReadingView instead.

is_final.description: One-way lock: when true the owner can no longer draw additional cards.

password_protected.description: Derived flag — true when a view password is set. The hash itself is never exposed.

daily_card_day.description: The day ("Y-m-d", the owner's local date) this reading is their daily card for; null for any other reading.

question.description: What was asked. Only its owner ever sees it.

querent.description: Who the reading was for, as the owner wrote it. Only its owner ever sees it.

tags.description: The owner's tags: lower-case, sorted. Only its owner ever sees them.

visibility.description: Who can open it: anyone with the link, anyone with its password, or (private) only its owner.

expires_at.description: When a guest reading will be deleted, UTC ("Y-m-d H:i:s"), as its maker chose; null for the usual retention. A reading made signed in never has one.

ReadingSpread.description: A spread the signed-in user's readings were laid out in, with how many.

name.description: The spread's name as the readings recorded it (personal spreads have no public id); "Free Draw" for free draws never placed. Send it as GET /account/readings?spread=.

count.description: How many of the user's readings were laid out in it.

ReadingSummary.description: A reading as the admin readings list shows it.

user_id.description: The owner, or null for a guest reading.

deck_name.description: The deck's name, or `Deck #<id>` once the deck is gone.

spread_name.description: The spread name, or empty for a free draw.

ReadingTag.description: A tag the signed-in user has given their readings, with how many carry it.

count.description: How many of the user's readings carry it.

category_id.description: The library category it is listed under.

category_sort_order.description: Its category's place in the list, from 1: the library and the spread pickers show the categories in this order.

positions.description:
Array of position objects, each shaped:
['order' => int, 'title' => string, 'x' => float, 'y' => float, 'rotation' => int,
 'description' => string (only when it has one)]

SpreadCategory.description: A heading the public spread library groups spreads under. Admins keep the list; every public spread is in exactly one.

sort_order.description: Its place in the list, from 1. The first category is the default for a new or approved spread.

spread_count.description: How many public spreads are in it.

User.description: A user account in its safe shape (no secrets or hashes).

has_password.description: Whether the account has a password at all. An account made by signing in with Google has none until the user sets one through a password-reset link.

sessionCookie.description: Session cookie issued on sign-in. Sent automatically by the browser.
sessionCookie.name: PHPSESSID

pluginToken.description: Personal access token issued to a linked Dalamud plugin (Authorization: Bearer …).
